briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is providing 3 months of free mobile recharge to all Indians.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and government sources, including the Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check Unit, have debunked the claim that Prime Minister Modi is providing 3 months of free mobile recharge to all Indians. These sources consistently state that no such scheme has been announced by the Prime Minister or the Government of India. They warn that viral messages circulating on social media, often leading to suspicious websites, are fake and attempts to defraud users through phishing scams. Some variations of the claim have been linked to specific events like Raksha Bandhan or the Mahakumbh Mela, and others to general election campaigns, all of which have been identified as false.
